subject.title: feat(plugins): tool-name matchers scope tool hooks and Codex native hook relay spawns

question: Should exact tool-name matchers become the shared public contract for tool hooks, trusted policies, and result middleware, rather than remaining a Codex-internal optimization?
rationale: This adds compatibility-sensitive behavior to three plugin registration APIs, and code review cannot decide the permanent matcher semantics or ownership boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve shared matcher API
options.body: Adopt exact-name matchers after fixing repeated-registration semantics and adding live Codex relay proof.

options.title: Keep scoping Codex-internal
options.body: Narrow relay installs through an internal registration contract without extending the public plugin APIs yet.

options.title: Pause for broader matcher design
options.body: Defer the PR until tool contracts, aliases, and future matcher expressiveness have one agreed plugin-wide design.

recommendation.title: Approve shared matcher API
recommendation.body: Adopt exact-name matchers after fixing repeated-registration semantics and adding live Codex relay proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history introduced and subsequently maintained the central Codex native hook relay behavior affected by this API decision.
